summary: abrdn Palladium ETF Trust filed an 8-K to announce a 5-for-1 forward share split of its abrdn Physical Palladium Shares ETF (PALL). The split applies to shareholders of record as of May 14, 2026, payable after market close on May 15, 2026, and effective before market open on May 18, 2026. Post-split shares will trade at one-fifth the pre-split NAV; ticker and CUSIP unchanged. The split is a mechanical adjustment that proportionally increases outstanding shares and decreases per-share price without altering total value. No change to business strategy, capital structure, or control. This is an ordinary corporate action, not a special situation.
